plainText:
YouTube is an online video sharing platform, owned and operated by . The service allows users to upload and view videos, comment on them, and subscribe to other users' "channels". As of June 2025, YouTube is the second most visited website in the world, and as of April 2020, over 2 billion users watch over a billion hours of content every day. Due to guidelines introduced to abide by the (COPPA), most content related to the Pokémon animated series and its s is marked for kids, disabling many features including comments. 

==Official Pokémon YouTube channels==
=== Active channels ===
 

=== Inactive channels ===
 

==Pokémon animation on YouTube==
===Pokémon Generations===
 
Pokémon Generations premiered in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Dutch on The Pokémon Company International's official channel for each language weekly between September 16 and December 23, 2016, and in Portuguese starting on February 10, 2017. The series was added to The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel between December 9, 2016, and February 2, 2017. 

===Pokémon: Twilight Wings===
 
Episodes of Pokémon: Twilight Wings premiered monthly beginning on January 15, 2020, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Pokémon Journeys===
 
For a limited time between March 18 to 31 and April 8 to May 31, 2020, every episode of Pokémon Journeys: The Series (that had aired before that time) was made available on the official YouTube channel of Japan for free .

===Pokémon: Indigo League===
 
In response to the continuing COVID-19 pandemic, between April 17 to May 12, 2020, two episodes of Pokémon: Indigo League were uploaded daily to the official YouTube channels of Malaysia, the Philippines, and Singapore as part of the "Home Fun for Pokémon Fans" campaign . Starting May 12, 2020, two episodes of the Cantonese dub of the series are being uploaded each day to the official YouTube channel of Hong Kong as part of the same campaign .

===POKÉTOON===
 
On The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels, episodes of POKÉTOON premiered monthly beginning on June 5, 2020 and June 17, 2022, respectively.

===Pokémon Evolutions===
 
Episodes of Pokémon Evolutions premiered weekly beginning on September 9, 2021, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Pokémon: Hisuian Snow===
 
Episodes of Pokémon: Hisuian Snow premiered monthly beginning on May 18, 2022, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Cube-Shaped Pokémon on Cubie Island?!===
 
Episodes of Cube-Shaped Pokémon on Cubie Island?! premiered monthly beginning on April 9, 2023, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and the English Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel.

===Pokémon: Path to the Peak===
 
Episodes of Pokémon: Path to the Peak premiered weekly beginning on August 11, 2023, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Pokémon: Paldean Winds===
 
Episodes of Pokémon: Paldean Winds premiered monthly beginning on September 6, 2023, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Detective Pikachu & the Mystery of the Missing Flan===
 
Detective Pikachu & the Mystery of the Missing Flan premiered on October 25, 2023, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Homecoming===
 
Homecoming premiered on February 6, 2024, on The Pokémon Company's official Traditional Chinese channel, as well as premiered on February 9, 2024 and February 10, 2024, on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels, respectively.

===Animated Pokédex===
 
On The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and The Pokémon Company International's official channels, episodes of Animated Pokédex premiered monthly beginning on December 16, 2024 and May 13, 2025, respectively. 

===Pokémon: Discover Paldea===
 
Episodes of Pokémon: Discover Paldea premiered on January 16, 2025 on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel and premiered on January 18, 2025 on The Pokémon Company International's official channels.

===Pokémon Concierge===
 
From February 21 to March 9, 2025, episodes from the first season of Pokémon Concierge were made available on the various official Pokémon YouTube channels as a part of Pokémon Day 2025 celebrations.

===Dragonite and the Special Delivery===
 
Dragonite and the Special Delivery premiered on February 27, 2025 on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel.

===Pokécology Diary===
 
Pokécology Diary premiered on July 11, 2025 on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese channel.

===The Pokémon Company Channels===
 
Starting from January 19, 2021, episodes of were made available on the Pokémon Asia ENG channel. These episodes were released every Friday and operated on a rotation, where the five most recent episodes would be available, with the first five episodes being permanently available. Other official YouTube channels managed by The Pokémon Company would eventually start uploading episodes of Pokémon Journeys: The Series. Eventually, the channels would begin uploading episodes of other series of Pokémon animated series. Eventually, for unknown reasons, some of the channels would privatize most or all of the episodes of certain series, such as Pokémon Journeys: The Series.

The following is the list of channels that have uploaded Pokémon animated series episodes to their channels.
 

===Miscellaneous===
The following is the official YouTube channel for the Pokémon animated series uploaded by third-party companies. Note that they may be geo-locked to their own respective countries.

 

==Movies & TV shows for sale==
 
It is possible to rent or purchase movies and TV shows through YouTube. YouTube is linked to Google's digital distribution service Google Play, and they share a catalogue; movies and TV shows purchased on YouTube are watchable on Google Play Movies & TV (or vice versa). It is possible to purchase or rent movies in 38 countries, and TV shows are available to purchase in , Austria, , , , Japan, Switzerland, the , and the . TV show rental is exclusively available in Japan .

===Pokémon animated series & movies available for purchase===
 

==YouTube Music==
YouTube Music is a music streaming service developed by YouTube that launched on November 12, 2015. The service is available for free with ads or as part of a YouTube Music Premium or YouTube Premium subscription. The service is available in 81 countries .
